title: LATAM Equity Index
description: Schema for artifacts/latam_equity_index.json — one record per LATAM population.

transplants_pmp.description: Kidney transplants per million population (most recent year available)

total_transplants.description: Absolute transplant count for the reported year

data_year.description: Year of the transplant data used

pgx_delta_tacrolimus.description: delta_vs_baseline (pp) for tacrolimus/CYP3A5 vs CEU. Negative = fewer patients requiring change vs European baseline.

pct_requiring_change.description: Percentage of individuals in this population requiring dose/therapy change per CPIC guidelines

access_gap.description: Global median pmp minus this country's pmp. Positive = below median (worse access).

pgx_gap.description: |delta_vs_baseline| — absolute pharmacogenomic divergence from European dosing baseline

equity_score.description: access_gap + pgx_gap. Higher = worse compounded inequity.
